title: Complete branded Space email and account messaging before launch
detail: Owner authorizes focused phased email/messaging development and recurring continuation. Execute static packets in docs/space-email-packets.json; derive dependency readiness using node scripts/space-email-program.mjs --json. Each feature packet becomes one canonical row with source.ref PROG-EMAIL1 packet:<key>, one consequence probe and one feature PR. Reuse/revalidate overlapping completed rows instead of reopening broad foundations. Daniel Tyack Space is owner-triggered pilot; 520 imported unknown-consent contacts remain excluded from marketing. No broadcasts or consent conversion. Website is live/prelaunch. Scope includes all 13 phases and separately gated opt-in mailbox synchronization; core launch does not depend on optional synchronization. Source plan is not shipped status.

verify.evidence: Not complete. Close only after all packet rows have passed their real consequence probes, preview/production status is documented, Daniel-triggered authenticated send/reply and a second-Space isolation pilot are observed, complete campaign accounting/failure recovery and measured latency are evidenced, and mailbox integration gates are truthfully resolved. No live test sends or provider changes performed during planning.
